main_text.head: PRÆFATIO .
main_text.p: malè agunt. Et in eo necessita-tis & coactionis casu protestor me non permissurum per Dei gratiam quantum in me erit, ut quis ita licentiosè Ecclesiæ pacem turbare ac veritatem eâ in parte violare ausit. Satis enim experientia Papatus per tot secula nos innumeris & inenarrabilibus modis docuit, quæ mala in Ecclesia & Rep. Euangelicâ expectanda essent, si contraria & nefaria illa doctrina Pontificia tanquam postliminio reduceretur. Et sint nobis in exemplum atque cautelam ea, quæ nunc in Angliâ & Scotiâ conti-gerunt

page.notes: The scan is faint and speckled in places but every word is legible. The heading ends with a printed space and full stop ("PRÆFATIO ."), kept as printed. The paragraph opens mid-sentence, so it continues from the previous page. The last line "gerunt" is right-aligned and completes the hyphenated word "conti-", so it is text, not a catchword. "&" stands for the printed Et-ligature and "&" for the printed ampersand-like sign.
